name: Hartford's Camp Courant
description_short: A free summer day camp for Hartford children with recreational and educational activities. It includes bus transportation from Hartford, free breakfast and lunch, a full-time nurse and free dental screenings.
special_needs_notes: A full-time nurse is on staff. In an emergency, campers go to the UConn Health Center, two minutes away.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers should bring a bathing suit and towel. Camp provides them if a camper has none. The camp publishes an Aquatics Safety Guide, but this page does not show its contents.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page shows the 2026 season (June 29 – July 31, 2026), which has already passed. No 2027 dates are listed.
The page mentions more than one program that each need separate registration, but it describes only one summer date range.
There is no drop-off at the campsite. Campers must ride the bus from their assigned stop and cannot attend if they miss it.
The site footer says © 2021-2023, so parts of the page may be out of date.
